title: How Great Leaders Inspire Action
speaker: Simon Sinek
scriptEn: How do you explain when things don't go as we assume? Or better yet, how do you explain when others achieve things that seem to defy all of the assumptions?
expressions: defy all assumptions (颠覆常规设想)
Or better yet... (甚至更进一步说)
strategy: 认知冲突设问 (Cognitive Dissonance)：连续抛出宏大对比问题制造好奇缺口。
transition: 递进衔接 (Escalation Pivot)：使用 'Or better yet' 提升演说张力。
